Two different populations, and **mine was the one that went unnamed.** ⚠️ This is this lane's own 「⭐⭐ NAME THE POPULATION」 rule — the one written down after objectui#9215's round produced 「I cannot name that population」 — failing in the hands of the seat that wrote it. ⛔ My reader excluded comment lines and not string literals, so it was answering a question nobody asked.

⚠️ **Third time this shift that my own leg was the defect while the work was sound** (errata 73a `### C.`, 73b objectui#9194 leg 1, now this). ⇒ ⭐ **A disagreement between my count and a dev's is not evidence the dev is wrong — it is evidence that one of us has not named the population, and it is at least as likely to be me.**

### ⛔ CORRECTION 2 — a wrong timestamp in my own review comment

`#issuecomment-5652524824` labels its CI reading 「at 09:53Z」. The reading was taken **before 09:46Z**. ⚠️ The COUNTS were accurate; only the label was wrong. ⛔ Recorded rather than left silent — ⭐ a seat that spends this much of its output insisting 「a line number is a measurement」 does not get to be loose with a timestamp on one.

### ⭐ Leg 5 is the fence that mattered, and it is mechanical

Triage ruled that removing `fork` from objectui#8616's set is a 门禁削弱 on the maintainer's floor. ⛔ Rather than read the diff and assert the convergence went upward, leg 5 compares 8616's set **as it stood on the real merge parent** against the shared constant: **byte-identical**. ⇒ objectui#8616's census is provably **not narrowed**; its entire diff is one import line plus deletion of its own copy.

### ⭐ Why this change needed a fixture at all — the part worth inheriting

The live `fork(` **call-site** population is **0** and stayed 0. ⇒ against the real tree, a run with `fork` in the set and a run without it are **byte-identical**, and a green suite would carry **no information whatsoever** about whether the fix works. The two `.fixture.ts` files supply the population the tree does not have; they carry `.fixture.ts`, which neither gate's `/\.(test|spec)\.tsx?$/` matches (leg 9), so the deliberately-leaking one ⛔ cannot redden the live gate — while `tsconfig.scripts.json` still type-checks it.

Under ablation the two NEW cases fail on `expected +0 to be 1` while the two **pre-existing** cases stay green. ⇒ ⭐ triage's 「绿色不携带任何信息」 turned from an argument into an observation.
